<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Bright Steel — Bars to Kilos
  PATH:   Custom/BrightSteel/Bars_To_Kilos.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Bright Steel sell steel BY THE KILO but customers order BY THE BAR. This is
  the quoting screen for that gap: pick a product, type a bar count, read the
  kilos — broken down by BATCH, because each batch was cut to its own average
  length and therefore weighs a different amount per bar.

      kg for N bars  =  N  x  Avg Length (m of the batch)  x  Kg per Metre (of the part)

  So 5 bars of batch MM7 at 5.82 m is not the same weight as 5 bars of batch
  AS13 at 5.08 m, and the quote has to say which batch it was priced from.
  Each row carries a COPY button that puts a ready-made line note on the
  clipboard ("5 bars - Batch MM7 @ 5.82 m = 22.14 kg") for the sales order, so
  the warehouse picks the batch the quote was based on.

  WHERE THE THREE NUMBERS COME FROM
    Kg per Metre   a PART CUSTOM FIELD, named "Weight per Meter" at Bright
                   Steel. Constant for the part (it is a function of diameter
                   and grade), so it lives on the part, not the batch. The
                   field is auto-detected by name — any field naming both a
                   weight and a length — and can be overridden in
                   Settings > Fields.
    Batch          a TEXT tracking field (parttracking.typeId = 10) whose
                   value is held per tag in `trackingtext`. Named "Batch
                   Number" at Bright Steel.
    Avg Length     a DECIMAL tracking field (parttracking.typeId 50 or 60)
                   whose value is held per tag in `trackingdecimal`. It is
                   METRES PER BAR. Named "Length" at Bright Steel.
    Both tracking fields are auto-detected from the tracking types the part
    actually carries, and can be overridden in Settings > Fields. Nothing is
    hard-coded to a tracking id, because those differ per database.

  QUANTITIES  (per part + location group, from tag x location in one pass)
    On hand       SUM(tag.qty)                      for tag.typeId IN (30,40)
    Committed     SUM(tag.qtyCommitted)             reserved on committed picks
    Not available SUM(qty - qtyCommitted)           in locations with
                                                    countedAsAvailable = 0 and
                                                    location.typeId <> 100
    Available     On hand - Committed - Not available, floored at 0
  That is Fishbowl's own available-to-pick formula. "Allocated" (open order
  demand) is deliberately NOT subtracted — it is demand, not reserved stock.
  The quantity views (QTYONHAND etc.) are TEMPTABLE, so a partId filter does
  not push down; the tag/location aggregation is reproduced inline instead.

  BARS ON HAND is DERIVED — kg on hand / (kg per metre x avg length). It is an
  estimate: bars are cut to an AVERAGE length and the real bar in the rack may
  be a few centimetres either way. Treat it as "about this many".

  SCOPE
    All location groups the user can see by default, with an optional
    location-group multi-select.

  STATUS: desk-built against the Fishbowl schema. NOT yet exercised against a
  live Bright Steel database — the part custom field and the two tracking
  fields do not exist in any test database, so the auto-detection and the
  Settings override both need a first run on site.

  DEPLOY ORDER (re-save on the server, in this order, or the report breaks):
    1. fb-styles  (Style  named exactly "fb-styles", source scripts/fb-styles.css)
    2. fb-lib     (Script named exactly "fb-lib",    source scripts/fb-lib.js)
    3. THIS report (the shared-asset directives only re-run on save)
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>- Sales - Bright Steel Bars to Kilos - Fishbowl BI</title>

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Moment.js — date formatting parity with the rest of the suite
         (FBLib.Common.formatDate prefers it when present). -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
         Script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. Provides FBLib.Common
         (formatting, drawers, multi-select, debug drawer), FBLib.Settings,
         FBLib.Table and FBLib.Export. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — inlined from the saved "fb-styles"
         Style (scripts/fb-styles.css). MUST come BEFORE the inline block so
         per-report rules win the cascade on identical selectors. -->
    <style>
        {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        /* =====================================================
           BASE + LAYOUT — tokens live in fb-styles; style new work off
           var(--…), never a hardcoded hex.
           ===================================================== */
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-primary); background: var(--bg-1);
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
        }
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* =====================================================
           INPUT BAR — always visible. This report IS its inputs, so they
           never hide behind a drawer.
           ===================================================== */
        #inputBar {
            display: flex; align-items: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px;
            background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 9px 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
            /* An open .ms-dropdown or the part typeahead must escape the bar
               rather than be clipped by it. */
            position: relative; z-index: 30;
        }
        .fbar-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
        .fbar-field > label {
            font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--c-secondary);
        }
        .fbar-field input[type=text] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; font-family: inherit; color: #415157;
            height: 28px;
        }
        .fbar-field input:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,0.18);
        }
        .fbar-ms { width: 210px; }
        .fbar-ms .ms-trigger { min-height: 28px; }
        .fbar-btn {
            height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff; color: #415157; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .fbar-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
        .fbar-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 8px; }

        /* The part input is wide — a Bright Steel part number carries the
           diameter and the grade, so 60px of box is useless. */
        #partInput { width: 250px; }
        /* Bars is deliberately type=text with inputmode, NOT type=number: the
           spinner arrows land on top of the digits at this height. */
        #barsInput { width: 88px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
                     font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }

        /* Typeahead popup under the part input. Mirrors the .ms-dropdown look
           so the bar reads as one design system. */
        .ac-wrap { position: relative; }
        .ac-dropdown {
            position: absolute; z-index: 700; top: calc(100% + 3px); left: 0;
            min-width: 320px; max-width: 520px;
            background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 7px;
            box-shadow: var(--sh2); max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .ac-dropdown.hidden { display: none; }
        .ac-item {
            display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px;
            padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-1);
        }
        .ac-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .ac-item:hover, .ac-item.active { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        .ac-item .ac-label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
        .ac-item .ac-sub   { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
        .ac-empty, .ac-loading { padding: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }
        .ac-loading { font-style: italic; }

        /* =====================================================
           PART BANNER — the head of the old paper card: size / grade /
           kg per metre / what is in the racks right now.
           ===================================================== */
        #partBanner {
            display: none; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 26px;
            background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff;
            padding: 9px 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        #partBanner.on { display: flex; }
        .pb-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; margin-right: 8px; }
        .pb-num  { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
        .pb-desc { font-size: 11.5px; color: #B7CBD4; }
        .pb-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; line-height: 1.2; }
        .pb-stat .k {
            font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #8FAEBB;
        }
        .pb-stat .v { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .pb-stat.hero .v { color: #7FD3F5; font-size: 19px; }
        .pb-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }
        /* A missing kg/m makes every kilo on the page wrong, so it is called
           out on the banner itself rather than left to the status line. */
        .pb-warn {
            background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con);
            border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); border-radius: var(--r-pill);
            padding: 3px 11px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* =====================================================
           APP SHELL + TABLE — the classes FBLib.Table.init expects.
           ===================================================== */
        .app-shell { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
        .fb-table-container { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: #fff; }
        table.fb-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; table-layout: fixed; }
        table.fb-table th {
            background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 500;
            padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: grab; user-select: none; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
            overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        table.fb-table th:active { cursor: grabbing; }
        table.fb-table th:hover { background: #164A5F; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-asc::after  { content: ' \2191'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-desc::after { content: ' \2193'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.col-drag-over { background: #164A5F; border-left: 3px solid #CBE5FB; }
        /* Everything worth filtering is in the bar above; hide the empty
           per-column filter row FBLib.Table renders. */
        table.fb-table tr.filter-row { display: none; }
        table.fb-table td {
            padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap;
            vertical-align: middle; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        table.fb-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: var(--bg-1); }
        table.fb-table tr:hover td { background: var(--tint-blue) !important; }
        .fb-col-resize { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 6px; height: 100%; cursor: col-resize; user-select: none; }
        .fb-col-resize:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

        .num-cell { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .muted-cell { color: var(--c-tertiary); }
        .batch-cell { font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
        /* The answer column. One thing on this screen is what she came for. */
        .quote-cell {
            text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fb-blue-accent);
        }
        .quote-cell.short { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-weight: 700; }

        .pill {
            display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
            font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .pill-ok    { background: var(--acc-sage);      color: var(--acc-sage-con); }
        .pill-short { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: var(--acc-maroon-con); }
        .pill-part  { background: var(--acc-yellow-bg); color: var(--acc-yellow-con); }

        .copy-btn {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;
            height: 21px; padding: 0 9px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
            font-family: inherit; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: #fff; color: var(--fb-blue-accent);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .copy-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        .copy-btn:disabled { border-color: var(--border-strong); color: var(--c-tertiary); cursor: not-allowed; }
        .copy-btn svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

        /* Empty / prompt state — the report starts with no part chosen, and
           an empty grid looks broken rather than expectant. */
        #emptyState {
            flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px;
            color: var(--c-tertiary); text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px;
        }
        #emptyState.hidden { display: none; }
        #emptyState .es-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        #emptyState .es-sub { font-size: 12.5px; max-width: 460px; line-height: 1.55; }

        /* Columns panel — a plain dropdown off the header button. Ordering and
           resizing happen on the header itself (FBLib.Table). */
        .col-wrap { position: relative; }
        #colPanel {
            position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 4px); z-index: 600;
            width: 232px; max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto;
            background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--sh2);
        }
        #colPanel.hidden { display: none; }
        #colPanel .col-head {
            padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--c-tertiary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); position: sticky; top: 0; background: #fff;
        }
        #colPanel label {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 11px;
            font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; color: #415157;
        }
        #colPanel label:hover { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        #colPanel .col-foot { padding: 6px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bg-2); position: sticky; bottom: 0; background: #fff; }

        /* Drawer chrome (settings / help). */
        .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #415157; }
        .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
        .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .ds-btn-admin { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); border-color: var(--acc-orange); color: var(--acc-orange-con); margin-right: 6px; }
        .ds-lock-badge { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
        .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
        .fb-grid-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); align-items: start; }
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-group { flex: none; min-width: 0; }
        .fb-group-title {
            font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--c-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .fb-field select, .fb-field input[type=text] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-1); font-family: inherit; color: #415157;
        }
        .fb-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.45; }
        .help-p { font-size: 12px; color: #415157; line-height: 1.5; margin: 4px 0; }
        .help-l { font-size: 12px; color: #415157; padding-left: 18px; margin: 4px 0; line-height: 1.55; }
        .help-eq {
            font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--bg-2);
            border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; margin: 7px 0; color: var(--c-primary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        /* The drawer backdrop scrim is injected + managed by fb-lib
           (registerDrawer -> #fbDrawerScrim). Never add a local scrim, and
           never override `.fb-drawer.open { z-index }` — the drawer must keep
           the fb-styles z-index (10001) that sits above fb-lib's scrim. */

        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar-track, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: 4px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; }

        @media print {
            html, body { overflow: visible; }
            @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 0.5in; }
            header, #inputBar, .hdr-btn, .fb-drawer, .fblib-debug-drawer, #colPanel { display: none !important; }
            .fb-table-container { overflow: visible !important; }
            table.fb-table th { position: static !important; background: #ddd !important; color: #000 !important; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="toast-container" id="toastContainer"></div>

<!-- ==================== HEADER ==================== -->
<header>
    <div>
        <h1>Bright Steel — Bars to Kilos</h1>
        <p id="statusLine">Loading…</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hdr-actions">
        <div class="col-wrap" id="colWrap">
            <button id="colBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="toggleColPanel()" title="Show / hide columns (drag a header to reorder, drag its edge to resize)">
                <svg fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="8" cy="6" r="1.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="18" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="6" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="18" r="1.5"/></svg>
                Columns
            </button>
            <div id="colPanel" class="hidden">
                <div class="col-head">Show / hide</div>
                <div id="colList"></div>
                <div class="col-foot">
                    <button type="button" class="fbar-btn" style="width:100%;" onclick="resetColLayout()" title="Reset column order, widths and visibility">Reset layout</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <button id="refreshBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="loadStock()" title="Re-read the stock for this part">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"/></svg>
            Refresh
        </button>
        <button id="csvBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="exportCsv()" title="Download the visible rows and columns as CSV">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/></svg>
            CSV
        </button>
        <button id="xlsxBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="exportXlsx()" title="Download as a formatted Excel workbook">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M8 8l8 8M16 8l-8 8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
            Excel
        </button>
        <button id="printBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="printReport()" title="Print the quote breakdown">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 17h2a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2h2m2 4h6a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2zm8-12V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4h10z"/></svg>
            Print
        </button>
        <span style="width:1px; height:18px; background:var(--border); margin:0 4px;"></span>
        <button id="helpBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('helpOverlay')" title="How to use this report">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 015.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
            Help

function _resolve(key, dflt) {

function _setUserKey(key, value) {

}
function debugLog(msg, type) { try { FBLib.Common.debugLog(msg, type || 'info'); } catch (_) {} }

// ============================================================================
//  CONSTANTS + STATE
// ============================================================================

// parttrackingtype ids, verified against a live table:
//   10 Text · 20 Date · 30 Expiration Date · 40 Serial Number
//   50 Money · 60 Quantity · 70 Count · 80 Checkbox
// At Bright Steel the two fields are named "Batch Number" (Text) and
// "Length" (Quantity). Batch values live in trackingtext; Length in
// trackingdecimal, which backs both 50 and 60.
var TRK_TEXT    = [10];
var TRK_DECIMAL = [50, 60];
// Count (70) is an integer type and cannot hold 5.82 m, so auto-detect will
// never land on one — but it is offered in the Settings drop-down anyway, so a
// site that configured its length field that way is not left with an override
// list that cannot reach it. trkTable() then reads from the right table.
var TRK_INTEGER = [70];
var TRK_LENGTH  = TRK_DECIMAL.concat(TRK_INTEGER);

// tag.typeId 30/40 are the two that count as on-hand inventory. location
// typeId 100 is a shipping location — goods staged to ship are on their way
// out, not "not available".
var ONHAND_TAG_TYPES = '30,40';
var LOC_TYPE_SHIPPING = 100;

var _part      = null;   // { id, num, description, uomcode, kgpm, kgpmField }
var _batches   = [];     // one row per batch, built by loadStock()
var _partCfs   = [];     // active part custom field names
var _partTrks  = [];     // tracking types this part carries
var _batchTrk  = null;   // chosen tracking def for Batch
var _lenTrk    = null;   // chosen tracking def for Avg Length
var _table     = null;
var _lgMs      = null;
var _lgAll     = [];     // [{value,label}] location groups the user can see
var _debugApi  = null;
var _loadSeq   = 0;      // guards against an out-of-order stock load

var fmtQty = function (v) { return FBLib.Common.formatQty(v); };

// ============================================================================
//  COLUMNS

var _columns = [
    {
        key: 'batch', label: 'Batch', width: 150,
        format: function (v, row) {
            return '<span class="batch-cell">' + escHtml(v || '(no batch)') + '</span>' +
                   (row.lenmixed ? ' <span class="pill pill-part" title="The tags in this batch do not all carry the same average length; the figure shown is weighted by weight on hand.">mixed</span>' : '');
        }
    },
    { key: 'avglen',     label: 'Avg length (m)', width: 120, align: 'right', qty: true,
      format: function (v) { return v ? '<span class="num-cell">' + num(v, 3) + '</span>' : '<span class="num-cell muted-cell">—</span>'; } },
    { key: 'kgperbar',   label: 'Kg / bar', width: 100, align: 'right', qty: true,
      format: function (v) { return v ? '<span class="num-cell">' + num(v, 3) + '</span>' : '<span class="num-cell muted-cell">—</span>'; } },
    { key: 'barsonhand', label: 'Bars on hand', width: 115, align: 'right', qty: true,
      format: function (v, row) { return barsCell(v, row); } },
    { key: 'onhand',     label: 'Kg on hand', width: 115, align: 'right', qty: true,

    { key: 'locnames',  label: 'Locations',        width: 240, vis: false, format: function (v) { return '<span class="muted-cell">' + escHtml(v) + '</span>'; } },
    { key: 'tagcount',  label: 'Tags',             width: 70,  vis: false, align: 'right', type: 'number' }

// ============================================================================
//  PART TYPEAHEAD
//  The list is queried per keystroke (debounced) rather than pre-loaded — a
//  steel merchant's part list is long and the user always knows roughly what
//  they are after.
// ============================================================================
var _acRows = [], _acActive = -1, _acSeq = 0;

function onPartInput() {
    var v = document.getElementById('partInput').value.trim();
    if (v.length === 0) { closeAc(); return; }
    showAc('<div class="ac-loading">Searching…</div>');
    _acDebounced(v);
}

var _acDebounced = debounce(function (term) { acFetch(term); }, 180);

async function acFetch(term) {
    var mySeq = ++_acSeq;
    var t = escSQL(term);
    // typeId 10 = Inventory. Only an inventory part holds tags, and only a
    // part that holds tags can have batches to quote from.
    var sql = [
        'SELECT p.id AS partid, p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, u.code AS uomcode',
        'FROM part p',
        'JOIN uom u ON u.id = p.uomId',
        "WHERE p.activeFlag = 1 AND p.typeId = 10",
        "  AND (p.num LIKE '%" + t + "%' OR p.description LIKE '%" + t + "%')",
        // Prefix matches first — typing "11.11" should not bury the part whose
        // number starts with it under every description that mentions it.
        "ORDER BY (p.num LIKE '" + t + "%') DESC, p.num",
        'LIMIT 25'
    ].join('\n');
    try {
        var rows = await qp(sql);
        if (mySeq !== _acSeq) return;          // a newer keystroke superseded us
        _acRows = rows || [];
        _acActive = _acRows.length ? 0 : -1;
        renderAc();
    } catch (e) {
        if (mySeq !== _acSeq) return;
        showAc('<div class="ac-empty">Search failed: ' + escHtml(errText(e)) + '</div>');
    }
}

function renderAc() {
    if (!_acRows.length) { showAc('<div class="ac-empty">No matching products</div>'); return; }
    var html = _acRows.map(function (r, i) {
        return '<div class="ac-item' + (i === _acActive ? ' active' : '') + '" data-i="' + i + '">' +
               '<span class="ac-label">' + escHtml(r.partnum) + '</span>' +
               '<span class="ac-sub">' + escHtml(r.partdesc || '') + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    showAc(html);
    document.querySelectorAll('#acDropdown .ac-item').forEach(function (el) {
        // mousedown, not click — it fires before the input's blur, so we beat
        // the blur-triggered close.
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            pickPart(parseInt(el.dataset.i, 10));
        });
    });
}

function showAc(html) {
    var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown');
    dd.innerHTML = html;
    dd.classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeAc() {
    var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown');
    if (dd) dd.classList.add('hidden');
    _acRows = []; _acActive = -1;
}

function pickPart(i) {
    var row = _acRows[i];
    if (!row) return;
    document.getElementById('partInput').value = row.partnum;
    closeAc();
    selectPart({
        id: parseInt(row.partid, 10),
        num: row.partnum,
        description: row.partdesc || '',
        uomcode: row.uomcode || ''
    });
}

function onPartKeydown(e) {
    var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown');
    var open = dd && !dd.classList.contains('hidden') && _acRows.length > 0;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && open) {
        e.preventDefault(); _acActive = (_acActive + 1) % _acRows.length; renderAc();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && open) {
        e.preventDefault(); _acActive = (_acActive - 1 + _acRows.length) % _acRows.length; renderAc();
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        if (open && _acActive >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); pickPart(_acActive); }
        else { e.preventDefault(); closeAc(); resolveTypedPart(); }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeAc();
    }
}

// Enter with nothing highlighted means "I typed the whole number" — resolve it
// as an exact match so a fast typist never has to touch the list.
async function resolveTypedPart() {
    var v = document.getElementById('partInput').value.trim();
    if (!v) return;
    try {
        var rows = await qp(
            'SELECT p.id AS partid, p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, u.code AS uomcode ' +
            'FROM part p JOIN uom u ON u.id = p.uomId ' +
            "WHERE p.num = '" + escSQL(v) + "' LIMIT 1");
        if (rows && rows.length) {
            selectPart({
                id: parseInt(rows[0].partid, 10),
                num: rows[0].partnum,
                description: rows[0].partdesc || '',
                uomcode: rows[0].uomcode || ''
            });
        } else {
            setStatus('No product numbered "' + v + '".');
        }
    } catch (e) { setStatus('Lookup failed — ' + errText(e)); }
}

// ============================================================================
//  PART SELECTION -> FIELD RESOLUTION -> STOCK
// ============================================================================
async function selectPart(p) {
    _part = p;
    _batches = [];
    if (_resolve('remember', true)) _setUserKey('lastPart', p.num);
    await resolvePartFields();
    await loadStock();
}

// Reads the part's kg-per-metre custom field and works out which of the
// part's tracking types are the Batch and the Avg Length. Both are overridable
// in Settings, because no two databases name these the same.
async function resolvePartFields() {
    if (!_part) return;

    // ── kg per metre ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var chosenCf = String(_resolve('kgpmCf', '') || '');
    var cf = chosenCf || autoDetectKgpmField();
    _part.kgpmField = cf;
    _part.kgpm = 0;
    if (cf) {
        try {
            var rows = await qp(
                "SELECT CustomFieldByName(p.customFields, '" + escSQL(cf) + "') AS v " +
                'FROM part p WHERE p.id = ' + _part.id + ' LIMIT 1');
            // The UDF hands back a string; a comma decimal separator or a
            // trailing unit ("0.761 kg/m") would otherwise parse to NaN.
            var raw = rows && rows.length ? rows[0].v : null;
            _part.kgpm = parseNum(raw);
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog('Kg-per-metre lookup failed: ' + errText(e), 'warn');
        }
    }

    // ── tracking fields ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    _partTrks = [];
    try {
        _partTrks = await qp([
            'SELECT pt.id AS trkid, pt.name AS trkname, pt.abbr AS trkabbr,',
            '       pt.typeId AS trktype, pt.sortOrder AS sortorder',
            'FROM parttotracking p2t',
            'JOIN parttracking pt ON pt.id = p2t.partTrackingId',
            'WHERE p2t.partId = ' + _part.id + ' AND pt.activeFlag = 1',
            'ORDER BY pt.sortOrder, pt.name'
        ].join('\n'));
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('Tracking lookup failed: ' + errText(e), 'warn');
    }
    _batchTrk = pickTracking(String(_resolve('batchTrk', '') || ''), TRK_TEXT,   /batch|lot|heat|cast|shipment/i);
    _lenTrk   = pickTracking(String(_resolve('lenTrk',   '') || ''), TRK_LENGTH, /len|length/i);

    debugLog('Part ' + _part.num + ' — kg/m field "' + (cf || '(none)') + '" = ' + _part.kgpm +
             ', batch = ' + (_batchTrk ? _batchTrk.trkname : '(none)') +
             ', length = ' + (_lenTrk ? _lenTrk.trkname : '(none)'), 'info');
    refreshFieldSelects();
}

// The part custom field carrying weight per metre. Bright Steel's is named
// "Weight per Meter" — note it says WEIGHT, not kg — so the detector matches
// on any mass word, not just "kg". Preference order: one of the canonical
// shapes exactly, then anything naming both a mass and a length word, then a
// field that simply starts "kg".
function autoDetectKgpmField() {
    var names = _partCfs.slice();
    var norm = function (s) { return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim(); };
    var MASS  = /\b(kgs?|kilos?|kilograms?|weight|wt|mass)\b/;
    // Bare "m" is safe here because norm() splits on punctuation, so "gm" in
    // "Unit Weight gm" stays one token and cannot match.
    var METRE = /\b(metres?|meters?|m|lm|lin|linear)\b/;
    var exact = names.find(function (n) {
        return /^(kgs?|kilos?|kilograms?|weight|wt|mass) (per )?(metre|meter|m|lm)$/.test(norm(n));
    });
    if (exact) return exact;
    var both = names.find(function (n) { var x = norm(n); return MASS.test(x) && METRE.test(x); });
    if (both) return both;
    var kg = names.find(function (n) { return /^kgs?\b/.test(norm(n)); });
    return kg || '';
}

// Which tracking-value table holds this definition's values. Everything
// numeric except Count lives in trackingdecimal.
function trkTable(def) {
    return TRK_INTEGER.indexOf(parseInt(def.trktype, 10)) !== -1 ? 'trackinginteger' : 'trackingdecimal';
}

// `wanted` is a saved tracking NAME (ids differ per database, names do not).
function pickTracking(wanted, typeIds, nameRe) {
    var pool = _partTrks.filter(function (t) { return typeIds.indexOf(parseInt(t.trktype, 10)) !== -1; });
    if (!pool.length) return null;
    if (wanted) {
        var exact = pool.find(function (t) { return String(t.trkname) === wanted; });
        if (exact) return exact;
        // The override names a field this part does not carry — fall through
        // to auto rather than silently showing nothing.
    }
    return pool.find(function (t) { return nameRe.test(String(t.trkname)) || nameRe.test(String(t.trkabbr)); }) || pool[0];
}

// ── STOCK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One indexed pass over tag x location. The quantity views (QTYONHAND etc.)
// are TEMPTABLE, so a partId filter does not push down and MySQL would build
// totals for every part in the database first.
function buildStockSQL() {
    var sel = [
        'SELECT',
        '  lg.id                          AS lgid,',
        '  lg.name                        AS lgname,',
        '  l.id                           AS locid,',
        '  l.name                         AS locname,',
        // bit(1) arrives in JS as a raw byte (String.fromCharCode(1)) and the
        // Fishbowl client strips control characters out of inline script, so
        // force it to a number here rather than comparing it in JS.
        '  (l.countedAsAvailable + 0)     AS counted,',
        '  l.typeId                       AS loctypeid,',
        '  t.id                           AS tagid,',
        '  t.qty                          AS qty,',
        '  COALESCE(t.qtyCommitted, 0)    AS committed'
    ];
    var joins = [
        'FROM tag t',
        'JOIN location l       ON l.id  = t.locationId',
        'JOIN locationgroup lg ON lg.id = l.locationGroupId'
    ];
    if (_batchTrk) {
        sel.push('  , tt.info AS batch');
        joins.push('LEFT JOIN trackingtext tt ON tt.tagId = t.id AND tt.partTrackingId = ' + parseInt(_batchTrk.trkid, 10));
    } else {
        sel.push("  , NULL AS batch");
    }
    if (_lenTrk) {
        sel.push('  , td.info AS avglen');
        joins.push('LEFT JOIN ' + trkTable(_lenTrk) + ' td ON td.tagId = t.id AND td.partTrackingId = ' + parseInt(_lenTrk.trkid, 10));
    } else {
        sel.push('  , NULL AS avglen');
    }

    var where = [
        't.partId = ' + _part.id,
        't.typeId IN (' + ONHAND_TAG_TYPES + ')'
    ];
    var lgIds = selectedLgIds();
    if (lgIds.length) where.push('l.locationGroupId IN (' + lgIds.join(',') + ')');

    return sel.join('\n') + '\n' + joins.join('\n') + '\nWHERE ' + where.join('\n  AND ') + '\nLIMIT 20000';
}

async function loadStock() {
    if (!_part) { renderAll(); return; }
    var mySeq = ++_loadSeq;
    var btn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Reading stock for ' + _part.num + '…');
    try {
        var sql = buildStockSQL();
        debugLog('Stock query:\n' + sql, 'query');
        var rows = await qp(sql);
        if (mySeq !== _loadSeq) return;        // a newer load superseded us
        _batches = groupByBatch(rows || []);
        debugLog('Loaded ' + (rows || []).length + ' tag(s) in ' + _batches.length + ' batch(es)', 'success');
        renderAll();
    } catch (e) {
        if (mySeq !== _loadSeq) return;
        console.error('[Bars to Kilos] stock load failed:', e);
        _batches = [];
        renderAll();
        setStatus('Load failed — ' + errText(e));
        debugLog('Load failed: ' + errText(e), 'error');
        showToast('Could not read stock: ' + errText(e), 'error', 8000);
    } finally {
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
}

// Collapse the tag rows into one row per batch, applying Fishbowl's
// available-to-pick formula as it goes.
//
//   available = on hand - committed - not available        (floored at 0)
//
// QTYNOTAVAILABLE sums (qty - qtyCommitted), NOT qty — stock that is both
// committed AND in a non-available location is therefore subtracted once, not
// twice. The three-term formula is only self-consistent because of that.
function groupByBatch(rows) {
    var map = Object.create(null);
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var key = (r.batch == null || String(r.batch).trim() === '') ? '' : String(r.batch).trim();
        var b = map[key];
        if (!b) {
            b = map[key] = {
                batch: key, onhand: 0, committed: 0, notavail: 0,
                _lenWeighted: 0, _lenWeight: 0, _lens: Object.create(null),
                tagcount: 0, _lgs: Object.create(null), _locs: Object.create(null)
            };
        }
        var qty = parseNum(r.qty);
        var cmt = parseNum(r.committed);
        var counted = parseInt(r.counted, 10) === 1;
        var locType = parseInt(r.loctypeid, 10);

        b.onhand += qty;
        b.committed += cmt;
        if (!counted && locType !== LOC_TYPE_SHIPPING) b.notavail += (qty - cmt);
        b.tagcount += 1;
        if (r.lgname)  b._lgs[r.lgname] = true;
        if (r.locname) b._locs[r.locname] = true;

        var len = parseNum(r.avglen);
        if (len > 0) {
            // Weight by the kilos sitting on the tag: a 2 t tag at 5.82 m
            // should dominate a 5 kg offcut tag that was keyed in at 2.5 m.
            var w = Math.abs(qty) || 1;
            b._lenWeighted += len * w;
            b._lenWeight += w;
            b._lens[len.toFixed(4)] = true;
        }
    });

    var kgpm = _part ? parseNum(_part.kgpm) : 0;
    var out = Object.keys(map).map(function (k) {
        var b = map[k];
        var avglen = b._lenWeight > 0 ? (b._lenWeighted / b._lenWeight) : 0;
        var available = Math.max(0, b.onhand - b.committed - b.notavail);
        var kgperbar = (kgpm > 0 && avglen > 0) ? kgpm * avglen : 0;
        return {
            batch:      b.batch,
            avglen:     avglen,
            kgperbar:   kgperbar,
            onhand:     b.onhand,
            committed:  b.committed,
            notavail:   b.notavail,
            available:  available,
            barsonhand: kgperbar > 0 ? (b.onhand / kgperbar) : null,
            barsavail:  kgperbar > 0 ? (available / kgperbar) : null,
            lenmixed:   Object.keys(b._lens).length > 1,
            tagcount:   b.tagcount,
            lgnames:    Object.keys(b._lgs).sort().join(', '),
            locnames:   Object.keys(b._locs).sort().join(', ')
        };
    });

    // Most stock first — the batch she is most likely to quote from is the one
    // with enough of it.
    out.sort(function (a, b) {
        if (!a.batch && b.batch) return 1;          // the (no batch) bucket last
        if (a.batch && !b.batch) return -1;
        return b.onhand - a.onhand;
    });
    return out;
}

// ============================================================================
//  QUOTE MATHS
//  Recomputed on every keystroke in the Bars box — no re-query, it is pure
//  arithmetic over what is already loaded.
// ============================================================================
function barsWanted() {
    var v = parseNum(document.getElementById('barsInput').value);
    return v > 0 ? v : 0;
}

function applyQuote() {
    var n = barsWanted();
    var onAvail = !!_resolve('quoteOnAvailable', false);
    _batches.forEach(function (b) {
        if (!(b.kgperbar > 0) || n <= 0) {
            b.quotekg = null; b.enough = ''; b.barsfit = null;
            b.pool = onAvail ? b.available : b.onhand;
            return;
        }
        b.quotekg = n * b.kgperbar;
        var pool = onAvail ? b.available : b.onhand;
        b.pool = pool;
        // FLOOR, not round: 0.83 of a bar cannot be shipped as a bar. This is
        // why the Bars columns print a fraction — see barsCell().
        b.barsfit = Math.floor(pool / b.kgperbar);
        b.enough = (b.quotekg <= pool + 1e-9) ? 'ok' : (b.barsfit > 0 ? 'part' : 'short');
    });
}

function visibleBatches() {
    var hide = !!_resolve('hideEmpty', true);
    return _batches.filter(function (b) { return !hide || b.onhand > 1e-9; });
}

// ============================================================================
//  RENDER
// ============================================================================
function renderAll() {
    applyQuote();
    renderBanner();
    var rows = visibleBatches();
    var has = !!_part;
    document.getElementById('emptyState').classList.toggle('hidden', has);
    document.getElementById('tableWrap').style.display = has ? '' : 'none';
    if (_table) _table.render();
    updateStatus(rows);
}

function renderBanner() {
    var el = document.getElementById('partBanner');
    if (!_part) { el.classList.remove('on'); return; }
    el.classList.add('on');
    document.getElementById('pbNum').textContent  = _part.num;
    document.getElementById('pbDesc').textContent = _part.description || '';

    var kgpm = parseNum(_part.kgpm);
    document.getElementById('pbKgpm').textContent = kgpm > 0 ? num(kgpm, 3) + ' kg/m' : '—';

    var rows = visibleBatches();
    var onhand = rows.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b.onhand; }, 0);
    var avail  = rows.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b.available; }, 0);
    document.getElementById('pbBatches').textContent = String(rows.filter(function (b) { return b.batch; }).length);
    document.getElementById('pbOnHand').textContent  = kg(onhand) + ' ' + (_part.uomcode || '');
    document.getElementById('pbAvail').textContent   = kg(avail) + ' ' + (_part.uomcode || '');

    // The headline figure: what the BEST batch gives for the bars asked for.
    // "Best" = the batch that can actually supply them, largest stock first;
    // if none can, the largest batch, so the number is still the honest one
    // for the stock she has.
    var n = barsWanted();
    var q = document.getElementById('pbQuote');
    document.getElementById('pbQuoteK').textContent =
        'Kg for ' + (n > 0 ? num(n, 0) : '0') + ' bar' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's');
    var best = rows.find(function (b) { return b.enough === 'ok'; }) ||
               rows.find(function (b) { return b.quotekg != null; });
    q.textContent = (best && best.quotekg != null)
        ? kg(best.quotekg) + ' kg' + (best.batch ? '  ·  ' + best.batch : '')
        : '—';

    // A missing kg/m is not a cosmetic problem — every kilo on the page
    // depends on it, so it is stated on the banner, not buried.
    var warn = document.getElementById('pbWarn');
    var msgs = [];
    if (!(kgpm > 0)) {
        msgs.push(_part.kgpmField
            ? 'No value in the "' + _part.kgpmField + '" part field'
            : 'No weight-per-metre field found');
    }
    if (!_batchTrk) msgs.push('No batch tracking on this part');
    if (!_lenTrk)   msgs.push('No average-length tracking on this part');
    if (msgs.length) {
        warn.textContent = msgs.join('  ·  ') + '  —  set it in Settings › Fields';
        warn.style.display = '';
    } else {
        warn.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function updateStatus(rows) {
    if (!_part) { setStatus('Pick a product to begin.'); return; }
    var n = barsWanted();
    var hidden = _batches.length - rows.length;
    setStatus(
        rows.length.toLocaleString() + ' batch' + (rows.length === 1 ? '' : 'es') +
        (hidden > 0 ? ' (' + hidden + ' with no stock hidden)' : '') +
        (n > 0 ? ' — quoting ' + num(n, 0) + ' bar' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') : ' — enter a bar count')
    );
}

// ============================================================================
//  LINE NOTE
//  The thing the whole report exists to hand over: a one-line instruction for
//  the sales order that names the batch the quote was priced from.
// ============================================================================
function noteFor(row) {
    var tpl = String(_resolve('noteTpl', '{bars} bars - Batch {batch} @ {length} m = {kg} kg'));
    var n = barsWanted();
    return tpl
        .replace(/\{bars\}/g,   num(n, 0))
        .replace(/\{batch\}/g,  row.batch || '(no batch)')
        .replace(/\{length\}/g, num(row.avglen, 3))
        .replace(/\{kg\}/g,     kg(row.quotekg))
        .replace(/\{part\}/g,   _part ? _part.num : '');
}

function buildCopyButton(row) {
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'copy-btn';
    btn.innerHTML =
        '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' +
        '<rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V4a2 2 0 012-2h9a2 2 0 012 2v1"/></svg>' +
        '<span>Copy note</span>';
    if (row.quotekg == null) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.title = "Needs a bar count, a batch average length and the part's kg per metre.";
        return btn;
    }
    btn.title = noteFor(row);
    btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        copyText(noteFor(row), btn);
    });
    return btn;
}

// Reports run from a data: URL, which is an opaque origin — navigator.clipboard
// is not always granted there, so the execCommand path has to stay as the
// fallback rather than being treated as legacy.
function copyText(text, btn) {
    var done = function () {
        showToast('Copied: ' + text, 'success', 3500);
        if (btn) {
            var lbl = btn.querySelector('span');
            if (lbl) { var old = lbl.textContent; lbl.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(function () { lbl.textContent = old; }, 1400); }
        }
        debugLog('Copied line note: ' + text, 'success');
    };
    try {
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, function () { legacyCopy(text, done); });
            return;
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    legacyCopy(text, done);
}
function legacyCopy(text, done) {
    try {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = text;
        ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:-1000px;left:-1000px;opacity:0;';
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        var ok = document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        if (ok) { done(); return; }
    } catch (_) {}
    // Last resort — show it so it can be copied by hand rather than failing
    // silently and leaving her to retype it.
    showToast('Could not reach the clipboard. Copy this by hand: ' + text, 'warn', 12000);
}

async function loadLocationGroups() {
    var ids = [];
    try { if (typeof getLocationGroupList === 'function') ids = getLocationGroupList() || []; } catch (_) {}
    var clean = (ids || []).map(function (n) { return parseInt(n, 10); }).filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
    var where = clean.length ? 'WHERE lg.id IN (' + clean.join(',') + ')' : '';
    try {
        var rows = await qp('SELECT lg.id, lg.name FROM locationgroup lg ' + where + ' ORDER BY lg.name');
        _lgAll = (rows || []).map(function (r) { return { value: String(r.id), label: r.name }; });
    } catch (e) {

}

function selectedLgIds() {
    if (!_lgMs) return [];
    return (_lgMs.getSelected() || [])
        .map(function (v) { return parseInt(v, 10); })
        .filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });

// ============================================================================
//  CUSTOM FIELD + TRACKING CATALOGUES  (for the Settings drop-downs)
// ============================================================================
async function loadPartCfs() {
    try {
        var rows = await qp([
            'SELECT cf.name AS name',
            'FROM tablereference tr',
            'JOIN customfield cf ON cf.tableId = tr.tableId',
            "WHERE LOWER(tr.tableRefName) = 'part' AND cf.activeFlag = 1",
            'ORDER BY cf.sortOrder, cf.name'
        ].join('\n'));
        _partCfs = (rows || []).map(function (r) { return r.name; }).filter(Boolean);
    } catch (e) {
        _partCfs = [];
        debugLog('Part custom fields unavailable: ' + errText(e), 'warn');
    }
    refreshFieldSelects();
}

// The two tracking drop-downs list what THIS part carries (plus whatever is
// currently saved, so an override for another part is never silently dropped).
function refreshFieldSelects() {
    fillSelect('setKgpmCf', _partCfs.map(function (n) { return { v: n, l: n }; }),
               String(_resolve('kgpmCf', '') || ''), autoLabel(_part && _part.kgpmField));

    var txt = _partTrks.filter(function (t) { return TRK_TEXT.indexOf(parseInt(t.trktype, 10)) !== -1; });
    var dec = _partTrks.filter(function (t) { return TRK_LENGTH.indexOf(parseInt(t.trktype, 10)) !== -1; });
    fillSelect('setBatchTrk', txt.map(function (t) { return { v: t.trkname, l: t.trkname }; }),
               String(_resolve('batchTrk', '') || ''), autoLabel(_batchTrk && _batchTrk.trkname));
    fillSelect('setLenTrk', dec.map(function (t) { return { v: t.trkname, l: t.trkname }; }),
               String(_resolve('lenTrk', '') || ''), autoLabel(_lenTrk && _lenTrk.trkname));
}
function autoLabel(detected) {
    return detected ? '(auto-detect — currently "' + detected + '")' : '(auto-detect — nothing found)';
}
function fillSelect(id, items, current, autoText) {
    var sel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = '';
    var auto = document.createElement('option');
    auto.value = ''; auto.textContent = autoText;
    sel.appendChild(auto);
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    items.forEach(function (it) {
        if (seen[it.v]) return;
        seen[it.v] = true;
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = it.v; o.textContent = it.l;
        sel.appendChild(o);
    });
    // A saved override for a field this part does not carry still has to be
    // visible, or "Reset to defaults" is the only way out of it.
    if (current && !seen[current]) {
        var o2 = document.createElement('option');
        o2.value = current; o2.textContent = current + '  (not on this product)';
        sel.appendChild(o2);
    }
    sel.value = current || '';
}

// ============================================================================
//  COLUMNS PANEL
//  FBLib.Table owns order / width / sort (and persists them itself on drag).
//  Visibility has no public setter, so toggling writes the same settings blob
//  the Table reads — keeping every other field it holds — and then repaints.
// ============================================================================
function buildColPanel() {
    var host = document.getElementById('colList');
    host.innerHTML = '';
    _table.getColumns().forEach(function (col) {
        var label = document.createElement('label');
        var cb = document.createElement('input');
        cb.type = 'checkbox';
        cb.checked = col.vis !== false;
        if (col.key === 'batch' || col.key === 'quotekg') {
            cb.disabled = true;
            label.title = 'The batch and the quoted kilos are the point of the report';
        }
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () { setColumnVisible(col.key, cb.checked); });
        var span = document.createElement('span');
        span.textContent = col.label;
        label.appendChild(cb); label.appendChild(span);
        host.appendChild(label);
    });
}

function setColumnVisible(key, visible) {
    var cols = _table.getColumns();       // same column objects the Table holds
    var col = cols.find(function (c) { return c.key === key; });
    if (!col) return;
    col.vis = !!visible;
    var saved = _resolve('tablePrefs', null);
    if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') saved = {};
    saved.order = cols.map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    saved.hidden = cols.filter(function (c) { return c.vis === false; }).map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    _setUserKey('tablePrefs', saved);
    _table.render();
}

function toggleColPanel() { document.getElementById('colPanel').classList.toggle('hidden'); }

function resetColLayout() {
    if (!confirm('Reset column order, widths and visibility to the defaults?')) return;
    _setUserKey('tablePrefs', null);
    _table.setColumns(_columns.map(function (c) { return Object.assign({}, c); }));
    buildColPanel();
    _table.render();
}

// ============================================================================
//  EXPORT + PRINT
// ============================================================================
function visibleExportCols() {
    return _table.getColumns().filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false && c.key !== '_copy'; });
}

// Plain text for a cell — the on-screen formatter emits HTML or a Node, so
// format the underlying value here instead of scraping the DOM.
function cellText(col, row) {
    var raw = row[col.key];
    if (col.key === 'batch')  return raw || '(no batch)';
    if (col.key === 'enough') return raw === 'ok' ? 'Yes' : raw === 'part' ? 'Part only' : raw === 'short' ? 'No' : '';
    if (raw == null || raw === '') return '';
    if (col.key === 'barsonhand' || col.key === 'barsavail') return barsNum(raw);
    if (col.qty) return num(raw, col.key === 'avglen' || col.key === 'kgperbar' ? 3 : kgDp());
    return String(raw);
}

function exportTitle() {
    var n = barsWanted();
    return 'Bars to kilos — ' + (_part ? _part.num : '') +
           (n > 0 ? ' — ' + num(n, 0) + ' bar' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') : '');
}
function exportFilename() {
    return 'BrightSteel_BarsToKilos_' +
           FBLib.Export.slug(_part ? _part.num : 'part') + '_' + FBLib.Export.stamp();
}

function exportCsv() {
    var rows = visibleBatches();
    if (!rows.length) { showToast('Nothing to export.', 'warn'); return; }
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    // Every cell is pre-formatted to text here, so the exported columns carry
    // no qty type — FBLib.Export must not re-format what is already formatted.
    var flatCols = cols.map(function (c) { return { key: c.key, label: c.label }; });
    var flatRows = rows.map(function (r) {
        var o = {};
        cols.forEach(function (c) { o[c.key] = cellText(c, r); });
        return o;
    });
    FBLib.Export.csv({ cols: flatCols, rows: flatRows, filename: exportFilename() });
    debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' batch row(s) to CSV', 'success');
}

async function exportXlsx() {
    var rows = visibleBatches();
    if (!rows.length) { showToast('Nothing to export.', 'warn'); return; }
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    try {
        await FBLib.Export.xlsx({
            filename: exportFilename(),
            sheet: {
                name: 'Bars to kilos',
                title: exportTitle(),
                subtitle: [
                    (_part ? _part.description : ''),
                    (_part && _part.kgpm > 0 ? num(_part.kgpm, 3) + ' kg per metre' : 'kg per metre NOT SET'),
                    new Date().toLocaleString()
                ],
                // Real numeric cells here, unlike the CSV path — Excel should
                // be able to add the kilos up.
                cols: cols.map(function (c) {
                    return { key: c.key, label: c.label, w: Math.round((c.width || 110) / 7), qty: !!c.qty };
                }),
                rows: rows.map(function (r) {
                    var o = {};
                    cols.forEach(function (c) {
                        o[c.key] = c.qty ? (r[c.key] == null ? '' : parseNum(r[c.key])) : cellText(c, r);
                    });
                    return o;
                }),
                totals: true
            }
        });
        debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' batch row(s) to xlsx', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('Excel export failed: ' + errText(e), 'error', 6000);
        debugLog('xlsx export failed: ' + errText(e), 'error');
    }
}

// window.print() is unreliable in JxBrowser — build the document, open a new
// window and print THAT.
function printReport() {
    var rows = visibleBatches();
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    var hdr = cols.map(function (c) { return '<th' + (c.align === 'right' ? ' class="nr"' : '') + '>' + escHtml(c.label) + '</th>'; }).join('');
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
        return '<tr>' + cols.map(function (c) {
            return '<td' + (c.align === 'right' ? ' class="nr"' : '') + '>' + escHtml(cellText(c, r)) + '</td>';
        }).join('') + '</tr>';

    var html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"/><title>Bars to Kilos</title><style>' +

        '</style></head><body><h2>' + escHtml(exportTitle()) + '</h2>' +

// ============================================================================

// ============================================================================
function applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
    if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
    if (!_debugApi) return;
    if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); } else _debugApi.hide();
    if (_debugApi.element) observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}
function observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible'), open = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {} }
    try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

// ============================================================================
//  SMALL HELPERS
// ============================================================================
function setStatus(msg) { document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = msg; }

// runQueryAsync resolves to an already-parsed array; runQuery returns a JSON
// string. Prefer the async one and fall back so the report still works on an
// older client. NOTE the name — a report-level function called runQuery would
// shadow the built-in and recurse forever.
async function qp(sql) {
    if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') return normalise(await runQueryAsync(sql));
    return normalise(safeParse(runQuery(sql, 'true')));
}
function normalise(r) { if (!r) return []; return Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r]; }
function safeParse(s) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (_) { return null; } }

function escSQL(s) {
    if (window.FBLib && FBLib.Common && FBLib.Common.escSQL) return FBLib.Common.escSQL(s);
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, '\\\\');
}
function escHtml(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
        .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
}

// Tolerant number parse. Custom-field values arrive as free text, so "0.761",
// "0,761" and "0.761 kg/m" all have to land on the same number.
function parseNum(v) {
    if (v == null) return 0;
    if (typeof v === 'number') return isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
    var s = String(v).trim();
    if (!s) return 0;
    // A comma with no dot is a decimal separator; a comma with a dot is a
    // thousands separator.
    if (s.indexOf(',') !== -1 && s.indexOf('.') === -1) s = s.replace(',', '.');
    else s = s.replace(/,/g, '');
    var m = s.match(/-?\d*\.?\d+/);
    var n = m ? parseFloat(m[0]) : NaN;
    return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

// A bar count DERIVED from weight is rarely whole, and rounding it lies in
// the worst possible way: 0.83 of a bar printed as "1" next to an "Enough? No"
// that had correctly floored it to zero. One decimal, trailing .0 trimmed, so
// a partial bar is visibly partial and the two columns agree.
function barsNum(v) {
    var r = Math.round(parseNum(v) * 10) / 10;
    return (r % 1 === 0) ? num(r, 0) : num(r, 1);
}
function barsCell(v, row) {
    if (v == null) return '<span class="num-cell muted-cell">—</span>';
    var whole = Math.floor(parseNum(v));
    var t = 'Worked back out of the weight: ' + kg(row.onhand) + ' kg at ' +
            kg(row.kgperbar) + ' kg a bar. ' +
            (whole > 0 ? whole + ' whole bar' + (whole === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' fit.'
                       : 'Not a whole bar.');
    return '<span class="num-cell" title="' + escHtml(t) + '">' + barsNum(v) + '</span>';
}

function kgDp() { var d = parseInt(_resolve('kgDp', '1'), 10); return isNaN(d) ? 1 : d; }
function kg(v)  { return num(v, kgDp()); }
function num(v, dp) {
    var n = parseNum(v);
    return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp });
}

function errText(e) {
    if (!e) return 'unknown error';
    if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
    if (e.message) return e.message + (e.status != null ? ' (HTTP ' + e.status + ')' : '');
    if (e.status != null) return 'HTTP ' + e.status;
    try { return JSON.stringify(e); } catch (_) { return String(e); }
}

function showToast(message, type, duration) {
    var host = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'toast ' + (type || 'info');
    var ico = { success: '✓', error: '✕', warn: '⚠', info: 'ℹ' }[type || 'info'];
    var icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'toast-icon'; icon.textContent = ico;
    var msg = document.createElement('span'); msg.className = 'toast-msg'; msg.textContent = message;
    var x = document.createElement('button'); x.className = 'toast-x'; x.innerHTML = '×';
    x.addEventListener('click', function () { el.remove(); });
    el.appendChild(icon); el.appendChild(msg); el.appendChild(x);
    host.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(function () {
        el.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function () { el.remove(); }, 260);
    }, duration || 4000);
}

function debounce(fn, ms) {
    var t = null;
    return function () {
        var args = arguments, self = this;
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(function () { fn.apply(self, args); }, ms);
    };
}

function clearAll() {
    _part = null; _batches = [];
    document.getElementById('partInput').value = '';
    closeAc();
    if (_resolve('remember', true)) _setUserKey('lastPart', '');
    renderAll();
    document.getElementById('partInput').focus();
}

// ============================================================================
//  INIT
// ============================================================================
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
    try {
        FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',  triggerId: 'setBtn'  });
        FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay', triggerId: 'helpBtn' });

        hydrateSettings();
        applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
        refreshAdminUi();

        // Bars is pure arithmetic over loaded data — repaint, never re-query.
        var bars = document.getElementById('barsInput');
        bars.value = String(_resolve('remember', true)
            ? (_resolve('lastBars', '') || _resolve('defaultBars', '1'))
            : _resolve('defaultBars', '1'));
        bars.addEventListener('input', debounce(function () {
            if (_resolve('remember', true)) _setUserKey('lastBars', bars.value);
            renderAll();
        }, 120));
        bars.addEventListener('focus', function () { bars.select(); });

        var partEl = document.getElementById('partInput');
        partEl.addEventListener('input', onPartInput);
        partEl.addEventListener('keydown', onPartKeydown);
        partEl.addEventListener('blur', function () { setTimeout(closeAc, 120); });

        // Location group filters in SQL, so a change re-reads the stock. Wired
        // on close, not on every tick — one query per dropdown session.
        _lgMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
            containerId: 'lgMs', items: [], placeholder: 'All location groups',
            onClose: function () {
                _setUserKey('lgIds', _lgMs.getSelected());
                loadStock();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var wrap = document.getElementById('colWrap');
            if (wrap && !wrap.contains(e.target)) document.getElementById('colPanel').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        _table = FBLib.Table.init({
            tableEl: document.getElementById('reportTable'),
            columns: _columns,
            getRows: visibleBatches,
            chunkSize: 200,
            settingsKey: 'tablePrefs'
        });
        buildColPanel();

        await Promise.all([loadLocationGroups(), loadPartCfs()]);

        var savedLg = _resolve('lgIds', null);
        if (_lgMs && Array.isArray(savedLg) && savedLg.length) _lgMs.setSelected(savedLg);

        // Courtney keeps this in a permanent tab — come back to the product she
        // was last on rather than to an empty screen.
        var last = _resolve('remember', true) ? String(_resolve('lastPart', '') || '') : '';
        if (last) {
            partEl.value = last;
            await resolveTypedPart();
        } else {
            renderAll();
            partEl.focus();
        }

        debugLog('Report initialised', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[Bars to Kilos init] failed:', e);
        setStatus('Init failed — ' + errText(e));
        debugLog('Init failed: ' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack : errText(e)), 'error');
    }
});
